name: Sony BRAVIA KD-55X85J
summary: Sony BRAVIA KD-55X85J ships with Samba TV tracking and promo tabs. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This South American Sony set ships with Samba TV, which fingerprints what is on screen. It also has Qterics and Sony device agents, a Sony bug-report uploader, and a service that shares viewing context with the home screen's recommendations. Sony promo apps, a Sony tab on the home screen, and retail demo and help apps are on the list too.

This set was checked over wired Ethernet on the day the list was applied, and the owner has not used it for days yet. Home, the remote's Input button and a reboot all worked after the list. Wi-Fi saved during setup was not tested. TidyTV turns the list off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: Netflix, YouTube, Prime Video, Disney+ and Apple TV
The voice assistant and Chromecast built-in
HDMI inputs, the Live TV tuner and the Sony input services
The remote, Sony settings apps and the TV's own system services
notes: The Input button on the remote still opens the input switcher, because the TV's own system handles it.
The ambient screensaver is switched off, so the screensaver shows a clock instead. Set the clock as the screensaver before the ambient one is switched off, or no screensaver will show.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Sony BRAVIA KD-55X85J?
faq.a: Yes. The voice assistant is kept on purpose, so it should still work. The Input button on the remote still opens the input switcher.
Yes. Chromecast built-in and AirPlay are both kept on purpose.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: Partly. It turns off the Sony promo apps, the Sony tab on the home screen and the Samba TV viewing tracker.
